thread:
sam: CI linkcheck is failing on #2401 — localized anchors with accents aren't resolving (mkdocs build). cc @anya for i18n context.
anya: saw that earlier. the slugifier treats composed vs decomposed Unicode differently so anchor ids mismatch between source and generated html.
kevin: can you paste the failing example?
sam: minimal repro in the PR:

```markdown
### Introducción
Contenido de ejemplo...
[Jump to Introducción](#introducción)
```

sam: linkcheck reports 404 for the anchor after build (the HTML id becomes "introduccion" sans accent due to slugify normalization).
elaine: quick fix: use Unicode-normalized explicit id on the heading: `### Introducción {#introduccion}` — ugly but works across both builders.
anya: longer term we should normalize all anchors in the linkcheck comparator (normalize to NFKD and ascii-fold) so links in source and generated HTML are compared consistently.
kevin: agrees. also update our mkdocs plugin config to use the same slugifier we use for Docusaurus (or at least the same normalization).
docs-bot: Reminder: add a docs checklist item "normalize i18n anchors or use explicit {#id}" when editing localized pages.
build-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck for PR #2401 started
build-bot: CI: linkcheck failed (anchor mismatch) — details in job log: https://ci.redwood-inference/builds/7890
kevin: filing ticket DOCS-827: unify slug normalization + add linkcheck normalization. Assigning to docs infra.
anya: I'll push a tiny PR to this branch adding explicit ids for the most troublesome localized pages so translators don't get blocked.
sam: thanks, pushed the interim patch. will re-run CI.
build-bot: CI: linkcheck passed for PR #2401 after patch 
any a: can we add an integration test that renders localized pages and asserts anchor resolution? cheap but prevents regressions.
kevin: yes — add to DOCS-827. prioritizing next sprint.
sam: ok merging once green. thanks everyone. :shipit:
